Container.Name: music-assistant
Container.Overview: Music Assistant is a free, open source music library manager. It brings your streaming services and your own files together into one library, and plays them on almost any speaker in the house.
Container.Description:
Music Assistant pulls your streaming services (Spotify, Tidal, Qobuz, and more), local files, radio, podcasts, and audiobooks into a single searchable library, automatically linking duplicate releases from different sources and filling in artwork, lyrics, and artist info. It streams to almost any player — Sonos, Chromecast, AirPlay, Squeezelite, DLNA, and others — with synchronized multi-room playback, gapless transitions, crossfade, and volume leveling. You can control it from any browser (it installs to your phone like an app) or pair it with Home Assistant for automations and voice control. This container runs the always-on server component, which acts as the core: it holds your library and coordinates your sources and players. Music Assistant is a project of the Open Home Foundation.
IMPORTANT - Network mode: This container requires Host networking. MA discovers and streams to players over mDNS/uPnP and protocols like AirPlay open random TCP/UDP ports, so it must sit on the same flat (layer 2) network as your players with no VLANs or firewall between them. Running it on a bridge network is only workable if you exclusively use software/software-only players and is not supported by the MA team.
Ports used (informational only under host networking - no mapping needed): 8095 (web UI) and 8097 (audio streaming to players).
Local music files: if you want MA to see your own files, bind-mount your music folder read-only (see the "Media" path below) rather than granting the container SMB/NFS mount privileges. Mounting the share on the host and passing it through is the more secure option recommended by the MA team. Only grant extra capabilities (SYS_ADMIN, DAC_READ_SEARCH, apparmor:unconfined via Extra Parameters) if you specifically need MA to mount a remote share itself from inside the container - this is not needed for most users and reduces container isolation.
Minimum hardware: 64-bit CPU (recent Intel/AMD, or a Raspberry Pi 4/aarch64 equivalent) and at least 2GB RAM (4GB+ recommended if the box runs other apps too). The first library sync can take a while depending on library size; later syncs are much faster.

Config.Name: App data
Config.Description: Persistent storage for the MA library database and settings.

Config.Name: Media
Config.Description: Optional: mount your local music share here (read-only) so MA can index it. Only needed if you use the Local Files provider.

Config.Name: Log Level
Config.Description: Log verbosity level. One of: critical, error, warning, info, debug.
